title: Here’s what happened in crypto today

title: King Charles to host AI chiefs amid industry call to slow development
summary: The gathering comes days after Dario Amodei and Sam Altman called for greater restraint at the AI frontier, warning that rapidly improving systems could pose increasingly difficult-to-control risks.

title: Robinhood CEO says issuers should not have veto over tokenized stocks
summary: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev said issuers should be involved if tokenized products change shareholder rights or company obligations, but not when they create separate instruments backed by shares.

title: US Republicans send ‘final’ CLARITY Act offer to Democrats
summary: The 635-page revised proposal includes Trump-backed ethics provisions and comes just two days before a key procedural vote.

title: Revolut attackers threaten daily customer data leaks
summary: Attackers reportedly published identity documents and selfies belonging to Revolut customers and threatened to release more data each day until the fintech pays.

title: Anthropic chief urges slowdown in AI development to safer pace

title: Revolut says customer data exposed through fake government email

title: North Korea using foreign talent to help infiltrate US companies: Report
summary: The DPRK has turned to third-country IT workers to pass job interviews, after which, the positions are usually taken over by North Korean operatives.

title: Farage’s Reform UK gets $97M from two crypto billionaires
